name: 12 Pcs Press On Nails Set With Floral Design & Rhinestone Decoration | Reusable False Nails With Nail Prep Kit
description:
Get a salon-style manicure at home with this 12-piece Press On Nails Set, featuring elegant floral patterns, beautiful rhinestone decorations, and a soft pink finish. Designed for quick and convenient nail styling, these artificial nails are perfect for parties, weddings, dates, photoshoots, special occasions, or everyday use. The set includes multiple nail sizes and essential preparation accessories to help you achieve a neat and stylish look with ease.

Key Features
12-piece press-on false nail set
Elegant floral design for a stylish and feminine look
Beautiful rhinestone decorations for added sparkle
Easy and convenient press-on application
Multiple sizes for a better fit on natural nails
Lightweight and comfortable for everyday or occasional wear
Reusable design when carefully removed and maintained
Includes essential nail preparation accessories
Perfect for parties, weddings, dates, events, and photoshoots
Ideal for creating a salon-inspired manicure at home

Product Specifications
Product Type: Press On / False Nails
Design: Floral & Rhinestone
Color: Pink
Quantity: 12 Pieces
Application: Natural Fingernails
Style: Decorative Nail Art
Suitable For: Home, Parties, Weddings, Events & Daily Use

How to Use
Clean and dry your natural nails before application
Select the press-on nail that best matches your natural nail size
Clean the nail surface using the included alcohol prep pad
Gently prepare your natural nails using the included nail tools
Apply the press-on nail carefully to your natural nail
Press firmly for a few moments to ensure proper placement
Avoid excessive water or pressure immediately after application
Remove gently when desired to help maintain the nails for possible reuse

Material / Composition
Artificial Nail Material
Floral Decorative Elements
Rhinestone Embellishments
Nail Preparation Accessories

Safety Information
Use only on clean and healthy natural nails
Do not apply over damaged or irritated nails
Stop use if irritation or discomfort occurs
Keep small accessories away from children
Avoid excessive force when applying or removing the nails
Store in a clean and dry place when not in use

Package Includes
12 × Press-On False Nails
1 × Alcohol Prep Pad
1 × Nail File
1 × Wooden Nail Stick
